author: Myv
body:
Hello, I am here to show you my 10th project after a small break from building. This was mainly due to school and the lack of motivation/imagination recently to build.

It is called Blocked, a small TDM map that is simple to navigate but with a few hidden secrets and pathways.

Note that it is very colourful, obviously, and although it is a basic design, I feel it is effective.

Map Information

Creators: Myv
Server Hosted: alexanderjoe
Team Colours: Cyan and Lime
Team Sizes: 15v15 (might be 20v20)
First to: 100
Time Limit: 15 minutes

Other Information

Download: Yet to be done
XML: Will be done if necessary.

Album: http://imgur.com/a/fYzYO

NOTE: The loadout/kit for each team is included in the images.

Thank you for viewing my map and feel free to leave feedback below.

Myv
